description: This is a 2.8km downhill mountain bike trail that is rated as moderate. Suitable for beginners/intermediate/advanced. It was machine built in 2010 in partnership with the Squamish Offroad Cycling Association and Dream Wizards.
directions: From hwy 99 and Mamquam Rd.(hwy 99 and Canadian Tire store) travel east towards Garibaldi Park/ Diamond Head area on Mamquam Rd, pass the Golf Course and leave the pavement and proceed straight ahead on the gravel rd, Garibaldi Park Rd. Aproximately 2 km past Quest University park at the junction of the Garibaldi Park Rd and the Ring Cr. FSR. at the end of the trail. Cycle uphill on the Ring Cr. Several maps of the cycling trails in the area are available along the climb.
title: Half Nelson Trail
